reference_model: OpenPBR / glTF metallic roughness and extensions; authored approximate starting values, not measured material data

reflection_modes.none: local BRDF only; no scene reflection query
reflection_modes.broad: local and low-frequency environment response only; no structured scene reflection query
reflection_modes.structured: scene reflection eligible according to physical lobe and rendering quality
reflection_modes.special: dedicated transmission, volume, screen or emission domain; do not implicitly admit general scene ray

state_axes.surface_liquid: independent typed film coverage and thickness
